title: BVEST 26 TMX
subtitle: Think. Prompt. Produce. This event brings together AI and music for those who believe they have the right combination of chords and code.
description: BVEST 26 TMX- Hosted collaboratively by OPTICA and AAGAAZ, this is an open to all event that aims to put the listening skills, creativity, and technical ingenuity of the participants to test, from identifying AI generated music to crafting original tracks, participants will explore the intersection of human creativity and AI-powered music production.
location: Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering, New Delhi
highlights: listening skills, creativity, and technical ingenuity of students.
